root_idea.summary: The root denotes bringing separate parts, persons, or things into mutual proximity or a unified whole.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of joining or drawing together, the root develops meanings of collecting, assembling, accumulation, union, comprehensive inclusion, resolution, and the state or place in which things come together.

senses.definition: To collect, gather, or bring separate persons or things together; to assemble or reunite them.
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively for people, objects, wealth, or other things that are brought together from a dispersed state; it can also describe bringing separated parties together.

senses.definition: To determine, resolve, or decide upon an affair; to settle one's plan for it.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially used with an affair, opinion, stratagem, or undertaking as its object; agreement or unanimity may result from the resolution but is not required in every occurrence.

senses.definition: To combine all one's means, resources, or stratagems for an undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: A constructional extension in which the things brought together are the available devices or resources for a planned action; it is explicitly discussed for the Quranic command concerning stratagems.

senses.definition: To come together, gather together, unite, or coalesce.
senses.usage_conditions: Intransitive or used with a companion or object of association; the subject may be a group, several things, or separate parties that become mutually joined.

senses.definition: All of them; altogether, as an emphatic corroborative of a preceding collective expression.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with a definite noun or pronoun to reinforce total inclusion and collective unity; the Quranic form أَجْمَعُونَ/أَجْمَعِينَ is inflected according to its syntactic position.

senses.definition: Gathering or assembling; one who brings persons or things together.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran it describes the divine gathering of people and may function as an active participle in a nominal predicate.

senses.definition: Collective or gathering-producing; an affair of such importance that people assemble because of it.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of an affair, event, or occasion that gathers people, rather than of the people who perform the gathering.

senses.definition: All, whole, or all together; collectively and without exclusion.
senses.usage_conditions: It may qualify a group or thing as a totality and may also be used adverbially to emphasize that an action is performed collectively.

senses.definition: A gathered body, assembly, collective group, or force.
senses.usage_conditions: It can denote a group of people or other beings, including opposing hosts or military forces considered as gathered bodies.

senses.definition: A gathering, collection, or occasion on which persons or things are brought together.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the act or event of assembly, including the eschatological Day of Gathering and the gathering of separate things.

senses.definition: Friday, the day of congregational gathering for prayer.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic proper-name use refers to the day on which people are summoned to the communal prayer.

senses.definition: A meeting place or junction; in the Quran, the place where the two seas meet.
senses.usage_conditions: A place-name or locative noun for the point at which separate bodies or things come together.

senses.definition: Collected, gathered, assembled, or brought together.
senses.usage_conditions: The passive participle can describe people or things gathered from separate places without implying that they have become a single object.

senses.definition: Coming together, assembled, or gathered into one group.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural form describes persons who are assembled or gathered together; it is the active-participle counterpart of اِجْتَمَعَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put on or arrange one's clothes around oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic Form I construction concerning clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach young womanhood or become full-grown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on the gathering or putting on of the items of a woman's dress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go in to a woman or have sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic and explicitly marked figurative Form I expression; the construction itself, not the gender or status of an illustrative subject, is lexical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compose, arrange, or settle a thing or an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical use in which parts or considerations are brought into an ordered state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To comprise, encompass, or contain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes something whose contents or components are gathered within it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pluralize a word or make it have a plural.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical technical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect or accumulate much, vigorously, or with unusually effective effort.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II intensifies the gathering or accumulation; it is distinct from the ordinary Form I and is discussed with the Quranic expression about amassing wealth, although no separate QAC Form II group is supplied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hen collected her eggs within her body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attend the Friday congregation and perform the Friday prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II use referring to attendance at the Friday gathering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To combine with and assist someone in carrying out an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III reciprocal or cooperative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have sexual intercourse with his wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III idiom; جِمَاعٌ is used as its associated verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hire a hired worker for a specified weekly payment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical construction preserved separately from the cooperation and sexual senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a thing together or drive a body of animals together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete Form IV use, including collecting spoil or camels from different quarters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare or make something ready.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV extension of settling the matter for action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bind all the teats of a she-camel together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural or pastoral construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dry or dry up a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV use, including drying pools or moisture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For rain to make all parts of the land flow, or for land to flow throughout its tracts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to water extending through both soft and hard ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw oneself from people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VII intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become compact, compressed, or contracted in frame or structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical extension of coming together, distinct from the Quranic gathering of persons or things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a man to attain full manly vigor and for his beard to become full-grown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical use explicitly restricted by the lexical evidence to a man, not a woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act quickly and vigorously in accomplishing a needed affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression portrays the person as collecting all his energy for the task.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a cooking pot to boil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a thing or affair to become composed, arranged, or settled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative state of internal parts or circumstances being brought into order.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To meet or associate with someone; to combine, conspire, or be allied with others against someone; or for opinions to agree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction with a companion or an affair expresses association or agreement; the construction against someone expresses concerted action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To summon or demand the gathering of every body of soldiers or military forces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form X use; the source itself notes that this usage may be post-Classical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become collected or gathered together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form X, explicitly equated with اِجْتَمَعَ and تَجَمَّعَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a torrent to collect from every place or flow throughout every part of a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use describing complete spread or collection of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For one's affairs or circumstances to combine favorably.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is a set of circumstances that all come together in a pleasing way.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exert all one's force or energy, especially in running or fighting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or intransitive Form X use of gathering one's strength.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a group to depart all together, with none remaining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized collective use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For herbs or leguminous plants to dry up completely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A proper name for al-Jamʿ, the place or tract where pilgrims collect, and for associated pilgrimage days.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A determinate geographical and ritual use, distinct from the ordinary noun for a gathering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The worst or mixed kinds of dates collected from several palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun referring to dates mixed together, often because of inferior quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Palm trees grown from date stones whose variety is unknown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Red gum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk collected in the udder of a camel whose teats have been bound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral term, contrasted with the milk of an unbound udder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clenched fist, or the quantity that a clenched hand can grasp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for the part where garments meet when someone is seized by the clothes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Concealed, undisclosed, or unknown with respect to an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression for an affair kept hidden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wholly or in its entirety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a month that has completely passed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Containing something retained within: said of a woman who is still a virgin or who is pregnant, and of a pregnant she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use explained as retaining something without separation; the alternatives of virginity and pregnancy are lexical variants reported in the evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of union, agreement, harmony, sociability, companionship, or friendship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The common noun denotes a condition of people being joined or congenial, distinct from the Quranic proper name for Friday.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The week, understood as the collective days of the week.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal or specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collection of things, such as a collection or handful of pebbles or dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for a gathered quantity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Plural or relating to a plural.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical or descriptive adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who fasts on Friday alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized religious-descriptive noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: That which comprises or embodies a number of things; an encompassing whole or essence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of something in which several matters are contained, as in what comprises sins or sayings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A very large cooking pot capable of containing a large quantity or an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjective or noun for a capacious vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person to whom a group resorts for counsel or authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the encompassing sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man compact or strong in build, not decrepit or infirm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having one's arms or weapons gathered and ready.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic construction describing equipment collected together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having sound, settled, or undisturbed judgment or counsel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic adjectival construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an unsettled affair firm, resolved, or decided.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction describing resolution after deliberation and changing possibilities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who collects much or collects many things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source presents this meaning with an indication of lexical analogy or probability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything whose component parts are collected or drawn together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a collected or integrated whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Short, when used as an epithet for a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cluster of the Pleiades, or people who gather in expectation of the rain associated with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical and cultural expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A medley or mixed multitude of people from various tribes, including people scattered or dispersed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun emphasizes a collection whose members are heterogeneous or formerly dispersed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place or source that comprises the origin of something, including the source from which people or tribes descend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension to origins, main tribes, or principal groupings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main or most essential part of a thing; specifically, the head of a human body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The clustering of the envelopes of date flowers in one place on the fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical term for a gathered formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal noun, explained by its containing what passes from the stomach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A congregational mosque, especially the mosque in which Friday prayer is performed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized active participle referring to a place that gathers people for prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large or comprehensive town containing a substantial population.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use for a town that comprises many people or functions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pregnant, in a specialized description of a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-ass that has only recently become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A neck-irons or collar that brings the hands together at the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for a restraint.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Concise speech that conveys many meanings in few words.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression for comprehensive language and for supplications combining several appropriate requests.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man combining qualities that make him suited to varied circumstances or combining all kinds of good qualities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beast fit for either of the specified kinds of saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel that has failed to put forth the expected tooth at the usual time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term with a specifically described stage of tooth development.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most comprehensive, containing the greatest number or quantity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A superlative adjectival use, distinct from the emphatic corroborative used in the Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Entire and complete in all limbs, with nothing missing or mutilated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a beast free from bodily defects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An extremely aged she-camel whose teeth have become short or nearly gone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal use reported alongside the meaning ‘entire.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where people assemble, such as an assembly room or sitting room.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A locative noun distinct from the specifically named junction of the two seas.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The whole of something considered as the place in which its parts are collected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative locative use for an encompassing whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An affair determined, resolved, or agreed upon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive-participial adjective can emphasize resolution or agreement depending on the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A discourse in which there is no flaw or defect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A year of drought, dearth, sterility, or unfruitfulness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained by the gathering of people where pasture or plenty can be found.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert in which travelers keep together rather than disperse, or land of dearth where animals cannot spread out to pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use of a place that causes people or animals to remain gathered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sands collected together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun; the same form is also reported for barren land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vacant or barren land without herbage, vegetation, or water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized geographical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Collected or assembled from different places, even when the items remain separate rather than becoming one thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader Classical description is the lexical basis of the Quranic passive-participle sense as well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place in which a thing becomes collected, contained, or united; a place containing a collection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A locative noun, including a container or site in which something comes together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The collective mass or whole of the hair of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who has attained full manly vigor and whose beard has become full-grown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use explicitly restricted to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw someone down gathered together or in a heap.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adverbial use describing bodily posture or compact arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To walk quickly and vigorously, with strength of motion rather than languor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adverbial use portraying the walker as gathering his bodily energy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main or central part of a desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place expression, literally the part in which the desert gathers itself.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Historical explanatory example of the Friday-congregation use.
Agreement in opinion is covered by settling or resolving upon an affair.
Same flow-through-every-part branch as the preceding unit.
Army or military force is covered by gathered body or force.
A clothing-grip subcase of the grasping or clenched-hand sense.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the preceding entry.
Friday prayer is the conventional construction associated with Friday.
A handful of dates is a concrete collected quantity.
The whole or all-of-anything use is covered by the Quranic totality sense.
A gathered tribe is covered by the collective-use sense.
The active-participle collecting sense is represented under the Quranic form.
The divine Collector use is covered by the Quranic gathering sense.
The momentous or people-gathering affair is the Quranic collective-affair construction.
The corroborative use is represented by the Quranic emphatic form.
Synonymic pointer without additional lexical content.
The broader passive-participle description is covered by the Quranic gathered sense.

cautions: أَجْمَعَ is presented separately as the Form IV verb ‘to resolve or combine one’s means,’ while أَجْمَعُ/أَجْمَعِينَ is presented as an emphatic corroborative.

The Form II discussion of intensive accumulation is retained as a Classical meaning because the packet supplies no separate QAC Form II form group; its Quranic example should not be mistaken for a QAC Form II occurrence.
The Lane Quran citations use historical notation in places; Quran examples here use only independently supplied QAC locations.
